metric: 8d. correlation coverage (alerts linked to a session / all alerts)
population_filter: all accepted SIEM alerts
late_event_policy: n/a (no ingest_time on alerts or flows)
null_policy: alerts whose source_ip is not a sandbox address are unmatched by construction and stay in the denominator
correlation_rule: source_ip = src_ip AND destination.host = dst_ip AND destination.port = dst_port AND |detected_at - flow_time| <= 60.0 s
